_comment: Dessert Person's ALL-CAPS asides inside a recipe (notes, variations, do-ahead advice) that are followed by prose, not ingredients. Used by ingest.py so these stay attached to their recipe instead of starting a new section. Component labels (CAKE, GLAZE, MANGO CARAMEL SAUCE) don't belong here: ingest and scaling recognize those on their own, because an ingredient follows them (common.text_parsing.is_component_label). This is book-specific: a missing file for a book just means it has no special case here.
